fullPassage: Studies from Belgium and Canada have shown that hypnosis increases the attention areas of the brain and the left hemisphere. According to the studies, it also decreases the perception of pain and the areas of the brain that perceive pain. Self-hypnosis can be a powerful tool for many different reasons, including help with sleep. When I was a medical intern at the Walter Reed Army Medical Center in Washington, D.C., many patients asked me for sleeping pills to help with the insomnia that goes with being sick in a noisy hospital. When insomnia and sleepiness occurred in the same person, it was largely due to common genetic factors. Before I handed them sleeping pills, I would hypnotize them and make them a self-hypnosis tape, and eight times out of ten they no longer needed them.

❌ ③ 최면이 열 번 중 두 번만 성공했다는 것: 여덟 번 성공이므로 정반대

❌ ④ 하루에 여덟 시간의 수면이 이상적이라는 것: 수면 시간과 무관하다
det.tip: eight times out of ten = 열 번 중 여덟 번 = 대개/거의 대부분. 높은 성공 빈도를 뜻하는 표현.
